title: Pan-Seared Mushroom and Adventurous Medley Stir Fry
description: A flavorful stir fry made with sautéed mushrooms, adventurous vegetables, and a hint of spices.

ingredients.name: adventurous
ingredients.notes: any combination of bell peppers, onions, carrots, and snow peas

ingredients.name: medley
ingredients.notes: any combination of broccoli, cauliflower, and zucchini

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the adventurous and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushroom and cook until browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the medley and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and serve hot.
